description: Assemblyman David DiPietro (R,C-East Aurora) is proud to announce the passage of Assembly Bill A.6969B, which designates the bridge over the New York State Thruway along Eden-Evans Center Road in the Town of Evans as the “Maintenance Supervisor Stephen C. Ebling Memorial Bridge.” This DiPietro-sponsored bill honors New York State Thruway Authority Maintenance Supervisor Stephen C. Ebling, who tragically lost his life while working in the Silver Creek Section of the Buffalo Maintenance Division i
title: Assemblyman DiPietro Announces Passage of Bill to Dedicate Stephen C. Ebling Memorial Bridge
